record.paper_title: Open problems in deformations of Artinian algebras, Hilbert schemes and around
record.original_question: For every point [Γ] in Hilb_d(A^3), is the parity of d the same as the parity of the tangent-space dimension at [Γ]?

evidence.quote: (Solved) problem XXV. Is it true that for every point [Γ] ∈ Hilbd(A^3) the parity of d and of the dimension of the tangent space at [Γ] is the same?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3)$ denote the Hilbert scheme parametrizing zero-dimensional subschemes $\Gamma \subset \mathbb{A}^3$ of length $d$ (equivalently, ideals $I \subset \mathbb{C}[x,y,z]$ with $\dim_{\mathbb{C}} \mathbb{C}[x,y,z]/I = d$). For a point $[\Gamma] \in \mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3)$, let $T_{[\Gamma]}\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3) = \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathbb{C}[x,y,z]}(I,\mathbb{C}[x,y,z]/I)$ denote the Zariski tangent space at $[\Gamma]$.

Determine whether the following holds: for every $d \geq 1$ and every point $[\Gamma] \in \mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3)$,
$$ d \equiv \dim_{\mathbb{C}} T_{[\Gamma]}\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3) \pmod{2}. $$
artifact.status_search_result: The parity conjecture is now resolved in the negative: a counterexample has been produced, namely an explicit family of zero-dimensional subschemes of length 12 in $\mathbb{A}^3$ whose tangent space dimension has parity different from 12. The conjecture is known to hold in special cases (monomial ideals, by Maulik–Nekrasov–Okounkov–Pandharipande, and homogeneous ideals), but fails in general.

status_evidence.title: A counterexample to the parity conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: A family of zero-dimensional schemes in Hilb^{12} A^3 disproves the parity conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: The general parity conjecture for Hilb_d(A^3) is false: there exists a length-12 counterexample.

status_evidence.title: On the parity conjecture for Hilbert schemes of points on threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: Proves parity conjecture for points parametrizing homogeneous ideals, extending the monomial case of Maulik-Nekrasov-Okounkov-Pandharipande.
status_evidence.claim: Parity conjecture proved for homogeneous-ideal points; monomial case earlier by MNOP.
